iEEGCoordinateSystemDescription: MNI coordinates of the intracerebral contacts as given in the release file 020_channels_TAL-MNI_coordinates.xlsx (columns MNI_x/y/z). The MNI template version is not stated in the release, so the system is recorded as Other rather than a specific MNI152 variant.
iEEGCoordinateProcessingDescription: Coordinates copied from the authors' xlsx table; no processing. Contacts absent from the table have x/y/z n/a.
